Jaithra Polavarapu, Nirmay Sharma, Havish Kunchanapalli, and Aarman Manna of Bentonville West High School are the winners of the 2025 Congressional App Challenge for their app, CropIntel AR. This app is designed to help Arkansas farmers protect their crops by providing instant, AI-powered diagnosis of diseases affecting our state’s top crops: rice, soybean, and cotton.

These juniors have the potential to become the next generation of entrepreneurs and leaders who will shape our region. It was an honor to present them with this well‑deserved award.
